LESSON: SHARING VALUES

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: question(s) Christian
Topic 4.1: Sharing values

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Sharing values. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify items shared at home to promote togetherness
2. share various items at home to enhance love and unity
3. narrate the story of the little boy with two fish and five loaves and practice kindness in their day to day life
4. appreciate the importance of keeping the environment clean by collecting litter

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify items shared at home to promote togetherness
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify items shared at home to promote togetherness. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. share various items at home to enhance love and unity
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to share various items at home to enhance love and unity. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. narrate the story of the little boy with two fish and five loaves and practice kindness in their day to day life
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to narrate the story of the little boy with two fish and five loaves and practice kindness in their day to day life. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate the importance of keeping the environment clean by collecting litter
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of keeping the environment clean by collecting litter. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Sharing values.
2. Explain Sharing values to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sharing values.
4. Show that you can: identify items shared at home to promote togetherness
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Sharing values. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Sharing values important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify items shared at home to promote togetherness
2. share various items at home to enhance love and unity
3. narrate the story of the little boy with two fish and five loaves and practice kindness in their day to day life
4. appreciate the importance of keeping the environment clean by collecting litter

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
